ctx.x: Benny Moten's band. And, the Count was one of the piano players. Benny was the piano and the Count was a piano player. And, that's the band he took over after Benny Moten passed.
But he, he had some very good musicians in there. And, I know you knew about Lester Young and Herschel Evans. Did you know about Herschel Evans?
